title: Austin Budgeting for Aviation & City Services
summary:
*   Austin officials held a special meeting to workshop the city's operating budget for the upcoming 1988-89 fiscal year.
*   Department heads presented proposed spending plans for key services, including Aviation, General Services, and Financial Services.
*   Budget outlines for the city's Audit and Law departments were also reviewed during the session.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - AUGUST 24,1988 - 9:00 A.M.
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Mayor Cooke opened the special
called meeting of the Council* noting the absence of Councilmembers Carl-Mitchell and
Urdy. Mayor Cooke announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a worksession on
Operating Budget for FY 1988-89.
Tim Ward, Director of Aviation, reviewed the Aviation Budget. Jim Hall reviewed General
Services. Financial Services budget was discussed by Earl Hoenes, acting director.
Stephen Klepper reviewed the Audit budget and Jonathan Davis, Acting City Attorney,
explained the Law Department's proposed expenditures.
Council adjourned its meeting at 12:10 P.M.
